recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source change is needed unless a future OO decision changes DiagnosticReport.subject target scope.
issue_request: FHIR-23808 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for FHIR-core DiagnosticReport asking to add BiologicallyDerivedProduct as one of the options for DiagnosticReport.subject, motivated by HLA genotyping on cord blood units from a biorepository.
initial_application: The request was applied by commit dad019edf3b011a7831615fa10fac3538ae1d352, which added the BiologicallyDerivedProduct targetProfile line to source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml. PR #1434 was merged as 096e56a8b38df08443755a401c6638b638feb081; the Jira comment cites the intermediate merge commit 3b6ad7182e3f1ef404feffa69a9705cac40c83df as added to build.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists both diagnosticreport=DiagnosticReport and biologicallyderivedproduct=BiologicallyDerivedProduct, so the checked resource definition and target resource are in build scope. OO WGM minutes from 2020-02-04/07 also record #23808 as persuasive with a 7-0-0 vote to add biologicallyDerivedProduct as a DiagnosticReport.subject reference option. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current combined-branch DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition already lists http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/BiologicallyDerivedProduct in DiagnosticReport.subject.
